const compareCmd = `python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json, re, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("tools").resolve()))
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime

root = Path.cwd()
items = json.loads((root / ".ai/task/repair-w31-20260925/WORKSET.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["items"]
expected = {
    (item["normalized_path"], item["section"], item["source"], item.get("source_tag")):
    item["entry_revision_identity"]
    for item in items
}
assert len(expected) == 23, len(expected)
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
changed = {}
non_target_changes = []
records_compared = 0
line_ok = 0
template_ok = 0

for rel in ("tome-ashes-urhrok.lua", "tome-cults.lua"):
    base_bytes = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "show", f"HEAD:{rel}"], cwd=root, check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE
    ).stdout
    old = loader.load_bytes(base_bytes, logical_path=rel).translations
    new = loader.load_path(root / rel, logical_path=rel).translations
    assert len(old) == len(new), (rel, len(old), len(new))
    records_compared += len(old)
    for before, after in zip(old, new):
        stable = ("kind", "function_name", "section", "source", "source_tag", "args_order", "special")
        if any(before.get(k) != after.get(k) for k in stable):
            non_target_changes.append((rel, before.get("line"), after.get("line"), "identity"))
            continue
        if before["target"] == after["target"]:
            continue
        key = (rel, after["section"], after["source"], after.get("source_tag"))
        revision = expected.get(key)
        if revision is None:
            non_target_changes.append((rel, after.get("line"), None, "target-outside-workset"))
            continue
        if revision in changed:
            raise AssertionError(f"duplicate changed revision {revision}")
        changed[revision] = key
        src_lines = after["source"].split("\\n")
        tgt_lines = after["target"].split("\\n")
        invariant = (
            len(src_lines) == len(tgt_lines)
            and [i for i,x in enumerate(src_lines) if x == ""] == [i for i,x in enumerate(tgt_lines) if x == ""]
            and [len(x)-len(x.lstrip("\\t")) for x in src_lines] == [len(x)-len(x.lstrip("\\t")) for x in tgt_lines]
            and [len(x)-len(x.rstrip("\\t")) for x in src_lines] == [len(x)-len(x.rstrip("\\t")) for x in tgt_lines]
        )
        if not invariant:
            raise AssertionError(f"line/TAB invariant failed: {revision}")
        line_ok += 1
        expr = re.compile(r"<\\?=.*?\\?>")
        if expr.findall(after["source"]) != expr.findall(after["target"]):
            raise AssertionError(f"template invariant failed: {revision}")
        template_ok += 1

missing = sorted(set(expected.values()) - set(changed))
assert not non_target_changes, non_target_changes
assert len(changed) == 23, len(changed)
assert not missing, missing
print(f"runtime={loader.runtime.luajit}")
print(f"records_compared={records_compared}")
print(f"changed_targets={len(changed)}")
print("non_target_changes=0")
print(f"line_tab_invariants={line_ok}/23")
print(f"template_invariants={template_ok}/23")
PY`;
const calls = [
  ["LUAJIT_COMPARE", compareCmd, 12000],
  ["STRICT_LINT", "python3 -B tools/i18n lint --strict", 12000],
  ["DIFF_CHECK", "git diff --check", 4000]
];
const results = await Promise.all(calls.map(async ([label, cmd, max]) => {
  const r = await tools.exec_command({
    cmd,

  });
  return [label, r];
}));
for (const [label, r] of results) text(`${label}\n${r.output}\nEXIT=${r.exit_code}`);

const verify = `python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("tools").resolve()))
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime

root = Path.cwd()
items = json.loads((root / ".ai/task/repair-w31-20260925/WORKSET.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["items"]
expected = {
    (item["normalized_path"], item["section"], item["source"], item.get("source_tag")):
    item["entry_revision_identity"]
    for item in items
}
assert len(expected) == 23
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
changed = {}
non_target = []
records = 0
target_record = None
for rel in ("tome-ashes-urhrok.lua", "tome-cults.lua"):
    base = subprocess.run(["git", "show", f"HEAD:{rel}"], cwd=root, check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE).stdout
    old = loader.load_bytes(base, logical_path=rel).translations
    new = loader.load_path(root / rel, logical_path=rel).translations
    assert len(old) == len(new), (rel, len(old), len(new))
    records += len(old)
    for before, after in zip(old, new):
        stable = ("kind", "function_name", "section", "source", "source_tag", "args_order", "special")
        if any(before.get(k) != after.get(k) for k in stable):
            non_target.append((rel, before.get("line"), after.get("line"), "identity"))
            continue
        if before["target"] == after["target"]:
            continue
        key = (rel, after["section"], after["source"], after.get("source_tag"))
        rev = expected.get(key)
        if rev is None:
            non_target.append((rel, after.get("line"), None, "outside-workset"))
            continue
        assert rev not in changed, rev
        changed[rev] = key
        if rev.startswith("1a5b7fe508"):
            target_record = after
assert not non_target, non_target
assert len(changed) == 23, len(changed)
assert set(changed) == set(expected.values())
assert target_record is not None
expected_target = (
    "你使你的恐魔与已死之神阿马克泰尔相协调，增加你召唤的恐魔 %d%% 伤害。\\n"
    "技能等级 3 后，你的腐败的吞噬者法术将额外召唤四名吞噬者在随机敌人周围，你的浮肿恐魔将学会极度痛苦。\\n"
    "技能等级 5 后，恐怖展示的受害者每回合会把范围 10 码内的敌人拉近 1 码。\\n"
    "伤害加成受法术强度加成。"
)
assert target_record["target"] == expected_target
assert target_record["target"].count("\\n") == 3
assert "\\t" not in target_record["target"]
print(f"runtime={loader.runtime.luajit}")
print(f"records_compared={records}")
print(f"changed_targets={len(changed)}")
print("non_target_changes=0")
print("selected_target_exact=true")
print("selected_target_lf=3")
print("selected_target_tabs=0")
PY`;
